note: Wooded hill access on the Big River south of Potosi, in a black bass special management area, with a hiking loop and a viewing deck; there is no boat ramp, so boats are carried to the water. The primitive campsites are beside the gravel turnaround at the end of the access road from Highway 21. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - 3 primitive sites (brochure 9/2022; sites.count 3 added) at the end-of-road gravel turnaround (the stored pin = GIS point), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit, Sept 15 - May 15. Conflict flagged: the page's area rule 140 now ends 'Camping is prohibited.' with no dates. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone matches.
flags: CONFLICT ON THE AREA PAGE: under area regulation '8212 - 3CSR 10-11 - 140 Camping' the page adds a line reading only 'Camping is prohibited.' (no dates), while the same page's Area Information says 'It also offers several primitive camping sites that are available Sept. 15-May 15' and Things to Do lists 'Individual Campsites'; the 9/2022 brochure says 'Camping is permitted September 15 through May 15 ... Camping is permitted only in designated areas.' Read as the seasonal closure with its dates dropped, so the stored manual season (Sep 15 - May 15) stands; if AWH wants certainty, the St. Louis Regional Office is (636) 441-4554.

INCLUSION/FIT: brochure: 'Bootleg Access provides walk-in access to the Big River ... Facilities include 3 primitive campsites, a viewing deck and a 1.5 mile hiking trail' - 'walk-in' describes river access (no ramp). Map shows one Primitive Camping symbol at the end-of-road lot; GIS point 91 (37.81480,-90.77095 = stored pin) is beside lot 410, a gravel turnaround ~25 m across at the end of a ~450 m gravel MDC road from Highway 21 (two more lots on the way). The three sites' own layout isn't shown; a 23-ft rig fits the turnaround. No ford, no posted limit.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the camping lot is ~100 m+ from the Big River through woods.
